meta.title: The Siege of Blackstone Keep
meta.subtitle: 🏰 An enemy army surrounds the castle. Your choices decide its fate.
meta.historyEmptyText: Your path will be recorded here as you make choices.

scenes.title: 🏰 The Siege Begins
scenes.narrative:
You stand atop the walls of Blackstone Keep.

⚔️ An enemy army stretches across the horizon.

🥁 War drums echo through the valley while banners wave in the cold wind.

In the distance, a massive trebuchet is being assembled.

The siege has begun.

choices.text: 🏹 Join the archers on the wall

scenes.title: 🏹 The Walls
scenes.narrative:
You take position beside the archers.

Enemy soldiers advance with shields raised.

💥 The trebuchet launches its first stone.

scenes.title: ⚔️ Castle Courtyard
scenes.narrative:
Soldiers rush through the courtyard preparing defenses.

🔥 Blacksmiths hammer weapons while supplies are handed out.

Everyone knows the attack is coming soon.

scenes.title: 👑 The War Room
scenes.narrative:
The commander studies a worn map.

'We cannot hold forever,' they mutter.

'We either break the siege… or survive it.'

scenes.title: 💥 Walls Crumbling
scenes.narrative:
The trebuchet smashes into the wall.

🪨 Stone explodes across the battlements.

One more direct hit could breach the castle.

scenes.title: ⚔️ Clash at the Walls
scenes.narrative:
Enemy ladders slam against the walls.

⚔️ Steel clashes around you.

The battle for Blackstone Keep has begun.

scenes.title: 🚪 The Gate
scenes.narrative:
You help reinforce the castle gate with heavy beams.

💥 A battering ram slams into it again and again.

scenes.title: 🗝️ Secret Tunnel
scenes.narrative:
Beneath the castle, you discover an old tunnel.

It leads outside the walls… dangerously close to the enemy camp.

scenes.title: 🌙 The Night Raid
scenes.narrative:
Under cover of darkness, you creep toward the trebuchet.

👁️ Guards patrol nearby.

One mistake could doom the mission.

scenes.title: 🔥 Sabotage
scenes.narrative:
You ignite the trebuchet.

🔥 Flames consume the massive machine as it collapses.

The enemy loses its strongest weapon.

scenes.title: 🥖 Endurance
scenes.narrative:
Days turn into weeks.

🥖 Food grows scarce and morale weakens.

But the enemy camp looks exhausted too.

scenes.title: 🛠️ Repair Effort
scenes.narrative:
You work quickly to reinforce the shattered wall.

💥 Another stone strikes… but the wall holds.

scenes.title: ⚔️ Turning the Tide
scenes.narrative:
With the trebuchet destroyed, the enemy begins to falter.

Their lines weaken as defenders rally across the walls.

scenes.title: 🛡️ Unbreakable
scenes.narrative:
The gate withstands the assault.

💥 The battering ram splinters apart.

Enemy troops retreat from the entrance.

scenes.title: 🩸 Wounded
scenes.narrative:
A blade catches your side during the fighting.

You retreat, injured but alive.

scenes.title: ⚔️ Breakout
scenes.narrative:
The castle gates open as defenders charge outward.

🔥 Chaos erupts beyond the walls.

scenes.title: ☠️ Caught
scenes.narrative:
You attack too early.

Enemy guards surround you within seconds.

The raid fails.

scenes.title: 💥 The Breach
scenes.narrative:
The walls finally collapse.

⚔️ Enemy soldiers flood into Blackstone Keep.

The castle falls.

scenes.title: 🏃 Escape
scenes.narrative:
You escape the siege under cover of chaos.

🏰 The fate of Blackstone Keep remains unknown.

You live… but at a cost.

scenes.title: 🛡️ Survivor
scenes.narrative:
After weeks of fighting, the enemy finally withdraws.

🏰 Blackstone Keep still stands.

You endured the siege.

scenes.title: 👑 Victory
scenes.narrative:
The enemy army breaks and retreats.

⚔️ Cheers echo across the walls of Blackstone Keep.

The siege is over.

You are victorious.
